pr_title: Inline signature evaluation branches in dependencies/utils.py
pr_description: Removes the shared _get_signature helper and inlines the Python-version check directly into get_typed_signature and get_typed_return_annotation. Keeps the eval_str=True call sites next to the function that uses them instead of routing through an extra layer of indirection.
